senses.gloss:
कद् क + द् (the old nom. acc. sing. n. of किम्; cf. Lat. quod; O.H.G. huaz; A.S. hvät).
 1. With following चिद् कच्चिद् कच् चिद्, particle of interrogation, [] Perhaps, Nal. 4, 24.
 2. As former part of compound nouns, Bad, e. g. कद्-अन्न, n. Bad food, Bhāg. P. 5, 9, 9.
 कद्-अपत्य, adj. Having a bad offspring, 4, 13, 43.
 कद्-इन्द्रिय, n. pl. The paltry organs of sense, 8, 3, 28.
 3. Combined with vb. दा, To blame, 7, 5, 28; with अर्थ्, q.v.

कद् कद्, or † कन्द् कन्द्, or † क्रन्द् क्रन्द्, or † क्लन्द् क्लन्द्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. † To be confused.
 2. † To confound.
 3. To kill; चकाद, Rām. 6, 65, 23.
कदन कद् + अन, n. Killing, Rām. 6, 65, 23.

कदम्ब कदम्ब,
 I. m. A tree, Nauclea cadamba (its flower, when fullblown, is covered with projecting anthers), Rām. 5, 74, 4; Kir. 5, 9.
 II. n. Plenty, Śāk. 87, 15 (Prākṛ.).

कादम्ब कादम्ब,
 I. m. A kind of goose, Rām. 3, 78, 27.
 II. i. e. कदम्ब + अ, n. The flower of the Nauclea cadamba, Roxb., Ragh. 13, 27.
 --Cf. perhaps, Lat. columba; κόλυμβος; O.H.G. tûba; A.S. dûua.
कदम्बक कदम्ब + क, n. Plenty, Śāk. d. 39.
कदर्थ कदर्थ, see कदर्थी under कृ.
कदर्थन कदर्थन. i. e. कद्-अर्थ् + अन, n. and f. ना, Tormenting, Daśak. 169, 7.
कदर्य कद्-अर्य, adj., f. या, Avaricious, Man. 4, 210.

कदल कदल,
 I. m. and f. ली, The plaintain tree, Musa sapientum, Megh. 75.
 II. f. ली, A kind of deer, MBh. 2, 1743.
कदलिका कदलिका, i. e. कदली + क, f. The plaintain tree, Prab. 65, 13.

कदा क + दा (see किम्), adv. At what time, Nal. 22, 7. With following चन,
 1. Once, some time; preceded by न, Never, Man. 2, 58.
 2. Perhaps, [] Pañc. 22, 10. With following चिद्, Once, Brāhmaṇ. 1, 2; preceded by न, Never, Man. 4, 74.
 3. Followed by अपि, and preceded by न, Never, Hit. 58, 12.
 --Cf. Lat. quando, quandoque = काद चिद्.
कद्रू कद्रू, f. The wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the serpent race, MBh. 1, 1074.

कादम्बरी कादम्बरी (for कादम्ब-वारि), f.
 1. The rain-water which collects in the hollow of the tree Nauclea cadamba when the flowers are in perfection, and which is supposed to be impregnated with their honey, Hariv. 5417.
 2. A spirituous liquor, Śāk. 76, 6 (Prākṛ.).
 3. A proper name, Sāh. D. 79, 18.
काद्रवेय काद्रवेय, i. e. कद्रू + एय, metron. m. A serpent, MBh. 1, 2549.
